title: Модальні дієслова
rule: Після модальних (must, should, can, could, might) інфінітив БЕЗ to: You must update it. Must/have to — обовʼязок; mustn't — заборона; don't have to — не обовʼязково. Should — порада; can't/must — висновок (He must be at home); might — слабка ймовірність. Минулий час від must/can — had to / could.

items.prompt: You ___ wear a helmet. It's the law.
items.explanation: Must виражає обовʼязок за правилом чи законом.

items.prompt: You ___ push to main without a review. It's forbidden.
items.explanation: Mustn't означає заборону.

items.prompt: You ___ come to the office tomorrow. We're working remotely.
items.explanation: Don't have to — немає потреби, а mustn't — заборона.

items.prompt: She can ___ three languages.
items.explanation: Після can — інфінітив без to і без -s.

items.prompt: I ___ work late yesterday, so I missed the party.
items.explanation: Must не має минулого часу — вживаємо had to.

items.prompt: You ___ have told me earlier! Now it is too late.
items.explanation: Should have + V3 — докір за те, чого не зробили.

items.prompt: He ___ be at home - his car isn't outside.
items.explanation: Can't be — впевнений висновок, що це неможливо.

items.prompt: The server ___ be down; I'm not sure. Let me check.
items.explanation: Might — слабка ймовірність, ми не певні.

items.prompt: When I was a child, I ___ swim very well.
items.explanation: Could — вміння в минулому.

items.prompt: Do I ___ install Docker before the interview?
items.explanation: У питанні з do вживаємо have to; після модальних to немає.

items.prompt: I ___ (can / not) open this file.
items.explanation: Заперечення від can — can't або cannot.

items.prompt: You ___ (must / not) use your phone during the exam.
items.explanation: Заборона — mustn't.

items.prompt: Last week we ___ (have to) fix the bug at midnight.
items.explanation: Минулий час від have to — had to.

items.prompt: You ___ (not / have to) wear a tie to the interview. It's casual.
items.explanation: Don't have to — не обовʼязково.

items.prompt: ___ (could) you send me the link, please?
items.explanation: Could — ввічливе прохання.

items.prompt: You ___ (should / not) commit passwords to Git.
items.explanation: Shouldn't — порада не робити.

items.prompt: You must to update the dependencies.
items.explanation: Після must не ставимо to.

items.prompt: I can to speak English a little.
answers: I can speak English a little.
items.explanation: Після can не ставимо to.

items.prompt: She don't can come today.
items.explanation: Заперечення від can утворюється can't, без do.

items.prompt: You don't must park here.
items.explanation: Заборона — mustn't, а не don't must.
